blurb: The Lovely Martha offers shared and private fishing trips, party cruises, special events, bay tours, and memorials at sea. The boat is a classic 50’ wooden-hulled vessel operating out of San Francisco Fisherman’s Wharf. Capt. Mike Rescino has provided fishing experiences for over 100 years through four generations of the Rescino Family.
